facts.text: I am trying to keep track of my rewards and points from various loyalty programs.
I use the Walgreens Balance Rewards loyalty program.
I use the Target RedCard loyalty program.
I use the Giant Eagle Advantage Card loyalty program.
I use the CVS ExtraCare card loyalty program.
I learned that 1,000 points from Walgreens is equivalent to $1 worth of rewards.
For Target RedCard, I get 5% off all purchases.
For Giant Eagle Advantage Card, I earn fuel points for every dollar I spend.
For Giant Eagle Advantage Card, 200 fuel points can be redeemed for 20 cents off per gallon at the gas station.
I earned 500 Walgreens points for buying a certain brand of coffee creamer that was on sale.
I got $2 in ExtraBucks rewards from CVS for buying sale items like toothpaste and mouthwash.
I have 200 fuel points so far.
I want a reminder to use my Walgreens Balance Rewards card every time I shop at Walgreens.

keyphrases: Giant Eagle Advantage Card fuel points
200 fuel points redeemed for 20 cents off per gallon
